mapper.select: SELECT doc_no docNo, doc_title docTitle, emp_name empName, doc_content docContent, status, createdate FROM document INNER JOIN emp ON document.emp_id = emp.emp_id WHERE emp.emp_id = ( SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE emp_id = #{empId} ) ORDER BY createdate DESC

SELECT doc_no docNo, doc_title docTitle, emp_name empName, doc_content docContent, status, createdate FROM document INNER JOIN emp ON document.emp_id = emp.emp_id WHERE emp.emp_id IN ( SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE dept = ( SELECT dept FROM emp WHERE emp_id = #{empId} ) ) ORDER BY createdate DESC
SELECT doc_no docNo, doc_title docTitle, emp_name empName, doc_content docContent, status, createdate FROM document INNER JOIN emp ON document.emp_id = emp.emp_id ORDER BY createdate DESC

SELECT doc_no docNo, emp.emp_id empId, doc_title docTitle, emp_name empName, doc_content docContent, status, createdate FROM document INNER JOIN emp ON document.emp_id = emp.emp_id WHERE doc_no = #{docNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document (emp_id, doc_title, doc_content, status, createdate) VALUES (#{empId}, #{docTitle}, #{docContent}, #{status}, NOW())
